title: Content coverage preserves original passive assets without bypassing its read-only request fence
steps: Run the content coverage passive asset transport regression without external services or model calls.
expect: External GET images, fonts and stylesheets preserve their original URL and response bytes through bounded transport.
Same-site and active requests retain their native browser transport.
POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE requests abort before any request fetch or fulfillment.
HEAD and OPTIONS remain native; failed asset fetches retain browser fallback.

tests: coverage keeps same-site and active GET
coverage falls back to the browser
